HUGE Improv Theater is a Minneapolis theater founded in 2005 dedicated to long form improvisational theater .

The non-profit theater acquired its own building in 2010 , where it runs scheduled nightly improv performances , acts as one of the Minnesota Fringe Festival 's venues , and hosts the annual Twin Cities Improv Festival .
The Peoples Improv Theater is an award-winning training center and comedy theater in New York City , founded by Ali Farahnakian in 2002 .

Philly Improv Theater , or PHIT -LRB- pronounced `` fit '' -RRB- , is a Philadelphia , Pennsylvania comedy theater which produces and presents shows at The Adrienne Theatre in Center City Philadelphia .
